text:
elaine: Quick follow-up: vendor auth throttling in eu-central caused model-registry reads to queue and produced a brief 5xx spike for hosted inference. Creating action thread for remediation and tracking.

sam: noted. any Dedicated tenant impact?

elaine: Two Dedicated tenants saw latency bumps for ~25m, overall 5xx ~1.8%. No persisted failures. Chain: vendor returned 429s on token introspect calls -> retries saturated registry client pools -> downstream 500s.

priya: vendor acknowledged a bad rate-limit config during a rollout. They're preparing an RCA and a quota correction.

jon: logs match the recurring "introspect-throttle" pattern we've tracked. Recommend treating as an incident class and tracking recurrence metrics.

marta: filed vendor ticket VND-2501 and flagged for priority response. Drafting customer comms in case CS needs it.

elaine: Proposed actions (owners + targets):
- Hotfix (HIGH): increase local token cache TTL for registry clients from 20s -> 4m and add randomized backoff. Owner: priya. Due: 3100080000.
- Short-term (MED): implement a circuit-breaker on token introspects to fail fast and avoid retry storms. Owner: sam. Due: 3100860000.
- Fallback (MED): prototype an auth fallback proxy that serves ephemeral tokens from a local signer (feature-flagged). Owner: sam + devsec. Due: 3101460000.
- Vendor (HIGH): request quota fix, dedicated auth key, and written postmortem. Owner: marta. Due: 72h.
- Runbook (MED): detection rule for introspect 429 burst + synthetic canary that simulates throttling. Owner: jon. Due: 3100045000.
- Governance (LOW): add recurrence tag and tracking metric to monthly resilience board. Owner: elaine. Due: next board meeting.

priya: taking hotfix. I'll open a small PR to bump TTL and add jitter + metric for cache hit ratio. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

sam: will design the circuit-breaker and evaluate fallback proxy options with devsec. Need to weigh KMS costs and rotation. ETA: 2 weeks for design, 3 weeks for a canary.

devsec: will review proxy threat model. Recommend ephemeral signing and strict audit trails; avoid static tokens.

jon: will add the detection rule and a staging canary job that injects 429s to validate mitigations. ETA: 5 days.

marta: vendor ticket updated; requesting immediate quota correction and postmortem. Drafting CS comms.

ops-bot: Logged items to tracker INC-2400: https://tracker.internal/INC-2400 (TOKEN-801, CB-802, PROXY-803, VND-2501, RUN-804).

elaine: scheduling weekly resilience syncs for 3 weeks then monthly. @sam please set calendar invites and include eng-sre, eng-platform, infra, devsec, and customer-success. Reconvene Friday EOD for status.

priya: ack, starting work.

sam: ack, will send invites and start design.

jon: ack, will draft runbook edits and detection rules.

marta: ack, monitoring vendor response.

devsec: ack, ready to review proxy design.

elaine: Closing thread—will update INC-2400 as actions progress. Reopen if vendor response or blockers arise. Thanks all.
